question: V100 INT8 Tensor Core inference speedup ratio benchmark

sources.title: NVIDIA V100 Inference Performance Analysis: INT8 Limitations ... - 淘寶
sources.snippet: The V100 is a beast for FP16 mixed-precision training, thanks to its dedicated Tensor Cores. However, modern inference heavily relies on INT8 quantization to squeeze out speed. Here is the catch: Volta's Tensor Cores do not support native INT8 matrix multiply-accumulate operations as efficiently as Ampere or Hopper architectures.
